name: Black Lily
source:
She is said to be a successful work of the goddess.

She has a glimpse of something and gives up everything that falls on her.

"You don't know anything. Same as me."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
